Checked the design's adapter/mapper/supervisor layering: the mapper and tool supervisor still publish through the adapter; the adapter's publisher now attributes those events to the open send's invocation. No layer, flow or rendering claim in the design changes.

Re-read the canonical event table and Tool Calls section: tool_call/tool_call_update still map to tool.started/progress/completed rendered by the shared tool UI; the change only adds the originating send's invocation (and the call's start turn) to those events, which this guide does not describe, so it stays accurate.
